title: Zombie wardrobe: bodies x slot wearables (iteration 07 refit) - prototype derivatives

t25Migration.note: Meshy T2.5 replacement of the locally generated characters: T2.5-sourced bodies / wearables are rebuilt from the accepted Meshy native GLB with the same CPU rig / fit pipeline; every rebuilt runtime file has a -t25 URL; kept bodies are verified, not rewritten

skippedWearables.reason: excluded on every body by the iteration-07 fit gate; no runtime model key (outfit-puffer.glb is an inert, unreferenced file); not in the T2.5 replacement inventory - left untouched

definitions.pairs: supported body x wearable pairs: each is a separately fitted, skinned and masked mesh variant (built here, validated by tests); excluded/covered pairs are not counted
definitions.looks: valid compositions per body (enumerated): one fitted wearable or nothing per slot the body does not cover, required slots filled, at least one wearable, no per-body layering incompatibility (iteration 07 incompatibleWear); registry incompatibleWith rules are applied on top by the runtime count
